ruling.recommended_action: Reject the fare-refund request (RydeX is fixed-price and the billed distance did not exceed the optimal route); note the RD-1 shortest-route breach for record only and offer RydeHELP review of the driver's routing.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 09:06–09:13 adds 4.84 km over a stretch where the optimal route covers 0.00 km. Not exempt under RD-3: no rider-named stop or app reroute appears in chat (F7, F8). Not exempt under RD-5: no pre-deviation route-change proposal with rider consent (F9 shows the driver only explained after the fact). Not exempt under RD-4: F12 records no traffic incident near the route, and the speed records F10 (band 5) and F11 (band 4) miss the band 1–2 threshold and cannot exempt alone. Breach of the RD-1 shortest-and-most-direct-route duty; no refund attachable because the fare is fixed (RD-2 non-metered branch, F4, F6).

rejected_claims.reason: RydeX is a non-metered fixed-price service; F4 shows billed distance equal to the optimal route and F6 contains no ERP/toll or unpublished add-on, so RD-2 yields a refundable amount of $0.00.
No traffic incident (F12) and only band 4–5 congestion (F10, F11) on other roads; RD-4 exemption not made out.
